intent: Compact icon-only toolbar control that triggers an action or reflects a toggled-on state.
use_when: An icon-only action or tool packed into a toolbar or grouped control row (bold, align, crop).
A binary formatting toggle whose on state is shown by passing the active prop.
dont_use_when: The control needs a visible text label — use Button.
Selecting one option from a mutually exclusive set — use SegmentedControl.

slots.icon: Required ReactNode rendered centered; host supplies the glyph.

tokens.note: Padding is hardcoded p-[4px] (not a spacing token); shrink-0 keeps it from collapsing in a flex toolbar.

a11y.focus: focus-visible outline bound to the c-focus-ring token; base outline is removed (outline-none).
a11y.note: Icon-only and unlabeled: the component renders no aria-label and forwards no aria props (only icon, active, onClick, className), so it has no accessible name and active is not exposed as aria-pressed. Provide a labeled wrapper host-side.
